name: Cloak of Shadows (Obfuscate, Basic, Dark Ages)

system.description:
You can conceal yourself as long as you remain silent, immobile and out from underfoot. As long as you do not move or produce noise and stay in shadows or behind cover, you are immune to all but magical scrutiny, and you may use the crossed-arms pose.

To indicate your concealed status, cross your arms in front of your chest, displaying a number of fingers on each hand corresponding to your highest level of Obfuscate (one for Basic, two for Intermediate, three for Advanced, four for Elder).
system.duration: Until movement or noise breaks it
